judged_text: The update test only exercises the changed-content path: the unchanged-content dedup branch (content_sha1 equality short-circuit) is never executed and the persisted update of embed.content_sha1 via update_column is never asserted. A regression that drops embed.update_column(:content_sha1, ...) or breaks the sha1 comparison passes the suite while every hourly PollFeed run re-revises the same post, spamming post revisions indefinitely.

adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, the dedup/short-circuit behavior depends on `if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1` and the changed-content path persists the new sha via `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)`. The spec `"Supports updating the post"` only exercises the changed-content branch by supplying different contents, and it never asserts that `topic_embeds.content_sha1` was updated (nor does any test exercise the unchanged-content branch where the method should *not* revise). So a regression breaking the sha1 comparison or removing the `update_column` could plausibly pass the current suite while causing repeated revisions in `Jobs::PollFeed` runs.
